_comment: Articles that predate the insertion-placement rule (Justin, 2026-08-13) and do not yet declare where they sit in the tree. This set MAY ONLY SHRINK — a new standard must declare its placement, and a grandfathered one that gains a placement is removed from here permanently. Enforcing all of these at once would have meant inventing 60+ placements by resemblance in a single pass, which is the unconsidered placement the rule exists to prevent.
